tests.name: parse_empty_containers

tests.name: parse_stream_input_adapter

tests.name: parse_deeply_nested_objects

tests.name: parse_callback_parser_execution

tests.name: sax_parse_cbor_format
tests.intent: Verify sax_parse with CBOR format exercises internal parsing paths.

tests.name: parse_large_number_members
tests.intent: Verify parsing large numbers and floating points as object members uses nothrow construct_member successfully.

tests.name: parse_with_unicode_strings
tests.intent: Verify parsing objects with unicode string values uses throwing construct_member path safely.

tests.name: parse_accept_method_check

tests.name: parse_with_special_floats

tests.name: parse_array_of_objects

tests.name: parse_empty_string_key_value
